stable.notes: Work gains an Intake view: what your meetings produced that is not on the board yet, with suggested meeting links, your items to review and other people's asks, each answered in place. Tasks show who their meetings involved. With a Jev (TypeSafe) key in Settings, Work suggests whether to continue, fork or start a session; it only suggests. Open in platform now opens the exact Claude session, including one Work ran on the server, and that session links back to its work. Pairs with server 6.57.0; run Update Server after updating.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
